dataset.name: Yale sun-exposed melanoma cohort (GSE190113)
dataset.description: Independent sun-exposed melanoma cohort with bulk tumor RNA sequencing and individual overall survival from tumor resection.
dataset.cohort_context: The source study profiled 60 sun-exposed melanomas by bulk RNA sequencing at Yale University. TRACE Explorer retains the 58 non-overlapping patient tumors with positive, individual overall-survival follow-up from the sequenced-tumor resection; two records with missing survival are excluded. The cohort contains primary and metastatic specimens, with metastatic stage-IV disease predominating.

metadata.source_program: Yale University acral and sun-exposed melanoma genomic study
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and the CC BY 4.0 publication
metadata.library_method: Tumor RNA was rRNA depleted, sequenced in bulk and quantified with Salmon against GENCODE v25. The source retained protein-coding genes, normalized to TPM, adjusted sequencing-center and year effects with parametric ComBat, replaced negative adjusted values with zero and applied log2(value + 1).
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival from resection of the sequenced sun-exposed melanoma tumor
metadata.endpoint_caveat: Most retained profiles are metastatic and stage IV, but primary tumors and earlier stages are also present. Expression-survival associations may reflect stage, specimen site or treatment history and should not be interpreted as an untreated natural-history cohort.
metadata.sample_selection_note: GEO contains one named bulk tumor profile per patient in this subcohort. Only subtype = SunExposed records are eligible; LOVY and WW165 are excluded because both survival time and event status are missing.
metadata.disease_selection_note: Sun-exposed melanoma is retained as a biologically coherent TCGA-SKCM analysis cohort and is not pooled with the source study's non-overlapping acral melanoma profiles.
metadata.expression_processing_note: The source ComBat adjustment was fit across the published 105-profile acral and sun-exposed RNA collection using sequencing center and year. TRACE Explorer preserves the resulting source scale and does not refit batch correction after subcohort selection.
metadata.overlap_note: This Yale cohort is independent of TCGA-SKCM and of the DFCI, checkpoint-inhibitor, adoptive-cell-therapy and hu14.18-IL2 cohorts already represented in the catalog. It shares a parent GEO series, but no patients, with the separately registered Yale-CSU acral subcohort.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO archive in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

source.time_characteristic: overall survival period from resection date (year)

samples.sample_role: Sun-exposed melanoma tumor sampled at the resection that defines survival time zero

expression.label: Source log2 ComBat-adjusted expression
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The 18,928 source protein-coding symbols are non-empty and unique case-insensitively in every selected profile.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer preserves the source's protein-coding, center/year-adjusted and log2-transformed values without an additional transform. Values are intended for within-cohort analysis and are not directly exchangeable with unadjusted TPM.

endpoints.label: Overall survival from sequenced-tumor resection
endpoints.time_origin: Resection date of the sequenced melanoma tumor
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause; living patients are censored at the source-provided follow-up
